https://forum.rclone.org/t/sync-is-not-removing-excluded-empty-directories-on-the-destination/46641/2


#### What is the problem you are having with rclone?

Rclone says it removing existing excluded directories, yet it removes only files.

- os/arch: amd64
- go/version: go1.22.4
- go/linking: static
- go/tags: cmount

#### Which cloud storage system are you using? (e.g. Google Drive)
